visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with a short beard wearing a brown work-style jumpsuit and a matching brown cap stands in a brightly lit, modern living room. He holds a white clipboard and a pen, gesturing with his hands as he speaks. Behind him is a grey fabric sofa with dark patterned cushions and a light-colored textured wall. A round white coffee table with snacks and tea is in the foreground. (2) The man performs a dynamic jump-kick move toward the couch, scattering orange snack items on the floor. He then strikes a contemplative pose, looking upward with arms crossed. The camera follows his movement with a slight handheld wobble. The room lighting remains bright and even, highlighting the clean interior design. (3) The scene shifts to a close-up of a digital tablet showing a blue-and-white architectural floor plan. A hand wearing a black glove points at specific sections of the drawing. The background is blurred, showing a desk environment. The editing uses a straight cut to focus on technical details. (4) A close-up shot shows a metal trowel spreading white adhesive in a notched pattern onto a ceramic surface. A hand then places a dark grey, fibrous insulation sheet over the wet mortar. The lighting is direct and focused on the textures of the materials, emphasizing the construction process. (5) The man walks through a professional showroom filled with hundreds of small square tile samples organized in a grid on the wall. He reaches out and pulls a large vertical display rack containing multiple large-format floor tiles. The environment is spacious and clean, with cool-toned overhead lighting. (6) Back in the living room setting, the man demonstrates a walking motion, followed by a close-up of his heavy black work boots as they step firmly on the light beige tiled floor. He then squats down, pointing toward the ground. The camera angle is low to emphasize the floor surface. (7) An animated cross-section diagram appears on screen, illustrating the different layers of a floor assembly including the RC structure, soundproofing layer, and surface tile. Labels in Chinese appear next to each layer. The background transitions back to the man in the showroom, standing with hands on his hips. (8) The man sits heavily on the grey sofa, then gets up and walks across the room, looking down at the floor tiles. He is wearing a silver watch on his left wrist. The scene uses a medium shot to capture his full-body movement within the living space. (9) In the showroom, the man stands before a wall labeled 'Color Collection.' He pulls out a very large, white-and-grey marble-patterned porcelain panel from a sliding mechanism. He gestures toward the panel's surface, showing its scale and finish. (10) The man stands between two large sliding tile panels. He waves at the camera with a small hand gesture as one panel slides shut, partially obscuring him. Finally, a brand logo for 'Champion Building Materials' appears on a white background with Chinese text and social media icons.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 恭喜各位! 被我恭喜到了. [Logo]: 超認真少年. (2) [Variety]: 恭喜! (3) [Subtitle]: 總算交屋了. 但是別高興得太早. 在交屋點交清單上面, 隱藏一個最大的惡魔. 那就是-噪音地獄. (4) [Variety]: 噪音地獄. (5) [Subtitle]: 你可以忍受未來樓上鄰居的小孩在地板上面跑酷嗎? 但是你只能在樓下崩潰發瘋. (6) [Variety]: 崩潰發瘋. (7) [Subtitle]: 很多人都以為隔音是設計師的事. 錯! 一開始你材料就選錯了. (8) [Variety]: 錯! (9) [Subtitle]: 一般人只會用磁磚或者是耐磨地板加上隔音層. 但你有沒有想過磁磚樓地板內建永久隔音層. (10) [Variety]: 磁磚樓地板內建永久隔音層. (11) [Subtitle]: 記得問清楚你的樓板隔音是怎麼做出來的呢. 如果你只是單純的鋪設隔音墊, 那其實你只能阻隔高頻. (12) [Variety]: 鋪設隔音墊. 僅阻隔高頻. (13) [Subtitle]: 低頻還是很難阻隔的. 如果你想要把聲音降很多, 那你就可以使用一種工法. 首先用隔音層, 再貼上堅硬的水泥壓層. 最後才貼上你喜歡的花紋款式磁磚. (14) [Variety]: 低頻難阻隔. 隔音層. 堅硬的水泥壓層. 花紋款式磁磚. (15) [Subtitle]: 為什麼要強調永久呢? 因為這是一個將隔音層固定在結構層上面的工法. 這樣才能夠成為建築物不可或缺的一部分. 它能夠永久有效的降低樓地板噪音. (16) [Variety]: 將隔音層固定在結構層上面. 能永久有效降低樓地板噪音. (17) [Subtitle]: 而這個呢, 是響應政府對於樓板隔音的法規趨勢. 提升建築物價值的關鍵. 所以買房子的時候, 記得用你的耳朵注意聽. (18) [Variety]: 提升建築物價值的關鍵. (19) [Subtitle]: 並且問一下你的建設公司是用哪一種工法蓋這個房子的. 想知道更多建築工法歡迎訂閱超認真少年頻道. 才不會前面省小錢, 後面花大錢. (20) [Logo]: 超認真少年頻道. [Slogan]: 訂閱. (21) [Subtitle]: 本集建材冷知識由冠軍建材贊助播出. 我們下次見. 掰噗. (22) [Logo]: 冠軍建材. [Variety]: 掰噗.
